items.title: Joseph "Red" Clark Interview, 1959-01-13
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You know Francis? I don't think so.

ctx.x: I saw a picture of him as a drummer one place.
Well he taught Francis to money a drums. You know Francis? I don't think so. He's a friend of Raymond.
He said he was in Papalina, I thought he was playing drums in that band. Well we'll ask Francis. How long did you take lessons?
